description.value:
Your patron lets you choose from an expanded list of spells. When you gain access to a new pact magic spell level, you can select one of the options listed for your patron. You learn that spell and it does not count against the number of warlock spells you know.

Archfey Expanded Spells
Spell LevelSpells
1stFaerie Fire, Sleep
2ndCalm Emotions, Phantasmal Force
3rdBlink, Plant Growth
4thDominate Beast, Greater Invisibility

1stCure Wounds, Guiding Bolt
2ndFlaming Sphere, Lesser Restoration
3rdDaylight, Revivify
4thGuardian of Faith, Wall of Fire

3rdCreate Food and Water, Meld into Stone (Dao), Wind Wall (Djinni), Fireball (Efreeti), Sleet Storm (Marid)
4thPhantasmal Killer, Stone Shape (Dao), Greater Invisibility (Djinni), Fire Shield (Efreeti), Control Water (Marid)
